Maria: Quick heads-up — I just flagged three PRs that need a manual review before tonight's RC. Links below. Can someone take a look? @Devon @Sahil :eyes:
Devon: On it, can you list which ones are blockers for the release vs optional?
Maria: Blocker: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/412 (runtime: kernel selection fix) — needs changelog and backport to release-1.2. Optional: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/98 (changelog only). Also https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/77 (quantization param tweak) — would like it in but non-blocker.
Sahil: I can review the infra PR now. If it's small, can approve + merge. If backport required, what's the cherry-pick target branch?
Maria: Target is release-1.2. If approved, please run:
```
git checkout release-1.2
git cherry-pick --no-commit 9f3b2a4
git push origin release-1.2
```
Also add label `changelog:required` and `backport:1.2` on the PR.
Devon: I'll do quick smoke on /models/77 in ~15m. For UI/98 can a PM confirm wording for the changelog?
Alex: PM confirmed wording in the doc, @Maria added copy to the PR description. For /ui/98 we just need an approval from design or product.
ci-bot: build infra #412 — failed on integration-test: kv-cache mismatch. Logs: https://ci/redwood/infra/412/logs
Sahil: I'll re-run tests after fixing a small race I spotted in the PR. If tests pass, will merge and trigger backport steps.
Maria: Thanks. Timeline — we need blockers merged within 2 hours for the RC pipeline. Ping here when merged and I'll update the release checklist.
Devon: /models/77 LGTM, left small comment about docstring but not blocker. Approving now.
Sahil: infra/412 tests passing now, backport pushed to release-1.2, added labels. Merging in 2m. :tada:
Maria: Awesome, thanks both — updating release page and marking as merged.
